role: The server-side block-breaking state machine of ItemInWorldManager (onBlockClicked, updateBlockRemoving, the delayed finish, cancel, tryHarvestBlock) against the native world, with what a survival break does: onBlockHarvested of the double plant, the chest's content drops, the silverfish spawn, the held tool's damage and breaking, harvestBlock's stat, exhaustion, silk-touch and drop paths, and the ice-to-water rule.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 37-38 and 49-50, functions block_named and item_named: exit(2) on a missing registry name
line 950-954, function dig_init: writes the global blockcb_env (world_rand, det, item_drop callback, ctx pointer to this dig_env)
line 124-125 in dig.h / line 97, function destroy_partial: progress rows go out through a function-pointer callback
notes: Drops of a normal break go through drops.c (drops_break with the world Random handed over as a seed and written back). Spawned entities are recorded into dig_env.ents (fixed array of DROPS_MAX_ENTS), not ticked; survival.c adopts them in the tape replay (role DET_SERVER) while the dig probe runs on DET_OTHER. Creative and adventure modes and extinguishFire are out of scope (dig.h). Recordings: out/java/dig (DigProbe dump for test_dig.c), and the pickaxe-complete-s1/s42 and screens-pickaxe-s1 snapshots exercise it through survival.c (not re-verified here). Every container's breakBlock spill (chest, trapped chest, furnaces, dispenser, dropper, hopper, brewing stand) runs through spill.c:container_spill before the write (container_drops), recorded with dig_ent.spill set so the adopt keeps pickup delay 0; the live replay (block_rands) draws the Block singletons' own block_rand, the dig probe its handed-over chest state. The silk-touch stack is harvestdrops.c's harvestdrops_create_stacked_block (podzol's meta, the double slabs' two halves, the side pillar's damage 2; lane/covblock).
